## About
The Rooter Dude is a family-owned and operated business that loves taking care of plumbing for our neighbors in Mount Juliet and across Middle Tennessee. No plumbing job is too big or too small, for homes or businesses.
We do the job up to code and try to get it right the first time. When something goes wrong late at night or on a weekend, call us. We're open around the clock, every day of the week.
Our customers have given us a 5 rating from 154 Google reviews, and they often mention Shane and Griffin by name.

## Services
- Drain Cleaning: Backed up sinks and slow drains cleared and flowing again.
- Drain Repairs: Repairs to drain lines, done up to code.
- Water Line Replacement: Replacing the water line that feeds your home.
- Home Plumbing Inspections: A look over your home's plumbing so you know where things stand.
- Drain & Sewer Camera Inspections: A camera inspection of your drain and sewer lines to see what's causing the trouble.
- Trenchless Sewer Repair: Sewer line repair without digging a trench across your yard.
- Hydro Jetting: High-pressure water to clear out stubborn lines.
- Leak Detection: Tracking down leaks so they can be fixed.

## FAQ
Q: Can I call you for an emergency in the middle of the night?
A: Yes. We offer 24/7 emergency service, every day of the week.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Give us a call to schedule your free estimate.

Q: Do you work on businesses as well as homes?
A: We do. We handle commercial and residential plumbing.

Q: How can I pay?
A: Our site lists Venmo and Zelle.
